prompt_text: Who is the best dentist in Columbus Ohio for a dental implant?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” dentist for implants—what’s best depends on your needs (simple single-tooth vs. full-arch, medical history, budget, timeline, insurance) and on the individual clinician’s experience and team. I can help you find the best match. Here’s how to identify a top implant provider in Columbus and what to ask at a consultation.

Who to look for
- A specialist: oral & maxillofacial surgeons, periodontists, or prosthodontists do the vast majority of implant surgery and complex restorative work. General dentists can place implants too, but for complicated cases you’ll generally want a specialist.
- Board certification / specialty membership: American Board of Oral and Maxillofacial Surgery (ABOMS), American Board of Periodontology, or American College of Prosthodontists shows additional training and standards.
- Collaboration: for complex restorations, look for teams that include both a surgeon and a prosthodontist (or highly experienced restorative dentist).

Quality indicators
- Extensive implant experience (ask how many implants they place per year and how many cases like yours they’ve done)
- Use of CBCT 3D imaging and digital planning (guided surgery, surgical guides)
- Ability to do bone grafting/sinus lifts if needed
- Clear restorative plan (who will make your crown/bridge/denture and how it’s coordinated)
- Before/after photos and patient references
- Good online ratings and consistent patient feedback across multiple sites (Google, Healthgrades, Yelp)
- Transparent fees, treatment timeline, and financing/insurance help

Where to search in Columbus
- Ohio State University College of Dentistry / Wexner Medical Center (specialty faculty and clinics provide advanced care and second opinions)
- Local periodontists and oral surgeons—search terms: “periodontist Columbus OH implants,” “oral surgeon Columbus OH dental implants”
- Review sites: Google Reviews, Healthgrades, Zocdoc, and insurance provider directories if you need in-network care

Questions to ask at a consult
- How many implant cases like mine have you done?
- Are you a specialist or board-certified? Which board?
- Do you use CBCT/imaging and guided implant planning?
- What implant system/brand do you use and why?
- Who will do the final crown/bridge/denture? Is that person in-house?
- What are the risks and expected success rate for my case?
- Will I need bone grafting or sinus lift? If so, how does that change cost/timeline?
- What is the total cost and payment/financing options? Are follow-ups included?
- Can I see before/after photos and hear from recent patients?

If you want, I can:
- Narrow the search by neighborhood/zip code in Columbus
- Suggest a short list of top-rated specialists (I can’t browse the web from here, but I can tell you how to evaluate any specific names you find)
- Draft an email or list of questions to send to clinics

Which would you prefer? If you give your zip code and whether you have a preference for specialist type (oral surgeon, periodontist, prosthodontist) or insurance, I’ll tailor the next steps.
